色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走

the female scientist sprints down a mist-shrouded forest path, lab coat flapping wildly behind her. Zombies lurch close in the moonlight. she dodges left, leaps over roots, hair whipping as the camera swings low and fast beside her, capturing every desperate stride. Leaves explode underfoot, breath ragged, camera shaking with her panic.

the female scientist ducks under a fallen branch, skids sideways through wet moss, then vaults a log without breaking stride. The camera spins around her mid-leap, then drops to ground level as she lands — zombies crashing through brush behind her, arms clawing air. Every frame pulses with speed; the forest blurs into streaks of blue and black.

the female scientist zigzags between gnarled trees, shoulders hunched, eyes locked ahead. Camera tracks from behind, then whips to her side as she nearly collides with a trunk — she twists at the last second, boots sliding on damp earth. A zombie lunges — she swerves, barely avoiding its grasp, and the camera jolts violently, mimicking her near-miss.

the female scientist charges onto a crumbling wooden bridge — planks crack underfoot as she races across. Behind her, zombies follow, but the bridge collapses mid-stride. She leaps the final gap, landing hard on dirt, rolling forward. Camera follows in slow-mo for the jump, then snaps back to real-time as she scrambles up and keeps running — no pause, no look back.

the female scientist sprints down a mist-shrouded forest path, lab coat flapping wildly behind her. Zombies lurch close in the moonlight — she dodges left, leaps over roots, hair whipping as the camera swings low and fast beside her, capturing every desperate stride. Leaves explode underfoot, breath ragged, camera shaking with her panic.

the female scientist enter into a distant bunker door glows green ahead — she throws herself forward, sliding under the closing metal slab just as it seals shut. Camera follows her full dive in slow-motion, then cuts to a tight shot of her gasping against the wall inside. Outside, muffled thuds echo… but she’s still moving — already pushing up, ready to run again. The camera stays glued to her — no rest, no relief.
